editorial.description: Real-time browser card game for 2–10 players on the couch. Built to prove a visual bar — Archer-coded illustration over Cloudflare Workers + Durable Objects.
editorial.oneLiner: Couch-of-friends spy comedy. Archer-coded card game in the browser.

editorial.description: Cloud data pipelines in the Azure focus stack — ADF, Databricks, Unity Catalog. The real question underneath: how do the agentic-workflow learnings from these projects apply to the enterprise data landscape?
editorial.oneLiner: Azure data engineering experiments. ADF, Databricks, Unity Catalog.

editorial.description: PreToolUse + Stop + PostToolUse hooks for Claude Code. Built after losing a session to WebFetch hanging — the rules are the lessons, and it's the source of the elite-engineer manifesto that ships into every session.
editorial.oneLiner: Claude Code hooks that gate, guide, and finish work.

editorial.description: Classic arcade clone with ghost AI. Built to test how small a game could be without frameworks.
Three custom Claude skills: /distill (preserve lessons), /brief (recall them), and a doc-audit quality gate. Built after losing context to fresh sessions one too many times.
editorial.oneLiner: Slash-commands Claude reaches for: distill, brief, doc-audit.

editorial.description: A personal retirement co-pilot: models cohort mortality, income, and drawdown to find the earliest date the math says you can walk away. Over 85,000 lines of test-pinned model in its first eleven days, every input traced to a verified primary.
Three-by-three grid, two players, classic rules. Built as a calibration project for the smallest scope project-metrics could measure.
editorial.oneLiner: The smallest possible game. Four files, one afternoon.

editorial.description: Top-down racing game with a learned agent driving the car. The foundation — TDR-04 inherits the engine and adds the polish.
editorial.oneLiner: The first racer. Where the self-driving agent was born.

editorial.description: Three tracks, sprite atlas, menu UI, and a 487-test verification baseline. Built end-to-end across 8 phases — the last game before the games-pause pivot.
editorial.oneLiner: The AI taught itself to drive the car. The polished racer.

editorial.description: Jackbox-style party game — shared TV screen, phone controllers, hidden-role voting. Its how-to-play page is 1700 lines of responsive HTML done right: single-column collapse, breakpoint-scaled type.
